user.title: Frieda Postfach
user.description: Inbox rules, push delivery and the daily overview for a Frieda account. Frieda Postfach uses the account's connection; no second password is needed. Existing rules of the account are picked up automatically.

abort.no_frieda: Set up the Frieda integration (friedafetch 2.0 or newer) first.
abort.already_configured: Frieda Postfach is already set up for every Frieda account.

automation.title: Frieda Postfach
automation.description: Daily overview: a short morning summary of unread e-mails, rule activity, today's events and birthdays.

data.rules_auto: Apply inbox rules automatically to new e-mails
data.rules_push: Push: apply the rules right after new mail arrives (IMAP IDLE)
data.digest_notify: Send the overview with (notify service; empty = notification in Home Assistant)
data.digest_ai_task: Phrase the overview with this AI task (optional)

ai.title: AI sorting
ai.description: Off unless you switch it on here AND choose an AI entity. New inbox mail that no rule handled is then rated by that AI: one of your categories, importance 1–5 and a short reason. The AI receives sender, recipients and subject, plus the first 1,000 characters of the text only if you allow it below. With a cloud AI this data leaves Home Assistant. The AI cannot delete or send anything. Start with "Only rate" and check the ratings in the panel before letting it act.

data.ai_include_body: Also send the first 1,000 characters of the text
data.ai_exclude: Kill switch: never send these senders or domains to an AI (one per line)
data.ai_block_terms: Kill switch: never send mail containing these terms to an AI (one per line)

data_description.ai_entity: An AI Task entity, e.g. from Google Generative AI, OpenAI or a local Ollama model.
data_description.ai_exclude: For example your bank, doctor or employer: bank.example, doctor@example.com
data_description.ai_block_terms: Checked locally in subject, sender and text before anything is sent, also for the AI daily overview. Example: diagnosis, salary, password

error.invalid_time: Please enter a time as HH:MM, e.g. 07:30.
error.ai_entity_required: Choose an AI entity, or switch AI sorting off.
error.ai_entity_invalid: This AI entity does not exist (any more).

send_digest.name: Send daily overview
send_digest.description: Sends the daily overview (unread e-mails, rule activity, today's events, birthdays) now.

account.name: Account
account.description: Label or Apple ID of the account (default: all accounts).

options.act: Run the category actions (move, mark read, flag)
